set.body: Add one rank-generic selection algebra above regions and point batches: per-axis All, bounded Slice(start, stop, stride), and ordered Indices selectors whose Cartesian product has an explicit output shape and preserves order and duplicates. Compile selections directly into deterministic chunk demands without expanding time-by-voxel or other factored gathers into a full coordinate product. Add decoded ChunkFragment values with logical source/output geometry and sync/async fold/foreach execution so callers can consume bounded pieces without allocating the complete result; retain collect as a convenience interpreter over the same plan. Missing chunks must produce lawful fill fragments, border chunks and empty axes must remain exact, and receipts must distinguish logical elements, fetched bytes, decoded chunks, and emitted fragments. Keep selection and stream planning pure/shared and runtime-rank; platform layers only schedule store/codec effects. Gates: plan coverage/no-overlap or declared duplicate semantics, arbitrary rank including scalar/rank-five, non-unit strides, descending or explicitly refused slices, repeated/unsorted gathers, overflow/resource limits, early termination/error propagation, sync/Scala.js parity, Zarr-Python/NumPy orthogonal-indexing differential fixtures, and an fMRI-shaped time-by-masked-voxel workload proving bounded planner memory. No dataframe API, NeuroArchive policy, prefetch/cache policy, or generic writer in this slice.
set.title: Zarr Z8.3: factored selections and streaming chunk fragments
